name: Bon Secours Hampton Roads Student/Junior Volunteer Program

offerings.cycle_label: Ongoing student and junior volunteer placements, Hampton Roads
offerings.summary: Bon Secours runs a student and junior volunteer route at its Hampton Roads hospitals for volunteers under 18 who want a short-term commitment.
issues: The hub page names a Student/Junior Volunteer program but publishes no age or grade rule
Neither fee nor pay information was located

offerings.cycle_label: Summer 2020 - the last cycle the hospital has published
offerings.summary: Teens who turn fourteen by 31 December of the previous year and hold a C average volunteer at Mary Immaculate Hospital for at least four hours a week over six weeks; the hospital's page still carries its 2020 dates.

age.raw: Must be 14 years of age by December 31st the previous year.

other: Provide two (2) teacher or counselor references
Complete volunteer orientation and tuberculosis screening before starting

sched.hours_raw: Able to volunteer at least four (4) hours per week for a minimum of six (6) weeks.

app.instructions: Complete the online Junior Volunteer Application, supply two teacher or counsellor references and the parental consent items, interview, then finish orientation and TB screening.

opens.raw: applications will be accepted from March 1 - April 17

deadlines.raw: applications will be accepted from March 1 - April 17
all attached paperwork must be filled out completely and submitted to the Volunteer Department no later than June 2, 2020

issues: The hospital's page still advertises the summer 2020 session, so no current cycle is announced. The eligibility rules and the March 1 to April 17 window are kept because they are the best predictor of the next cycle.
Page content dates from 2020 and needs a telephone check before publication.
